source: The Operations Director has a Friday go/no-go meeting for a four-week Harbor Hub dispatch pilot starting Monday. The proposed pilot costs $28,400 all-in, against a $32,000 cap. Approve the pilot on Friday only if both readiness checks have passed. Safety must sign the revised loading plan. Leah Mensah owns that sign-off and is due Wednesday at 5 p.m. Integrations must verify that a carrier-tracking replay delivers all required events end to end. Ravi Shah owns that check and is due Thursday at noon. Both checks are still pending. If either check is still pending or fails at the Friday meeting, defer the pilot and keep the current dispatch process. The pilot uses one hub and existing shift coverage. It would give Operations data on delivery reliability before any broader rollout, which requires a separate decision. The team also discussed a new dashboard color and an internal launch announcement. Those are separate from the approval decision.
